cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Wait before you go. You said our wedding venue was booked for Friday. This says Monday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Monday was cheaper. Can you sign? I'm late for work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Stay while I read it. You told me Friday was confirmed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was. I moved it after we sent the invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then work needs to wait. Explain when you planned to tell the Friday guests.

mechanism: A responds to its pupil unilateral wedding change with the old double-checking lesson, holding B until the omitted communication is accounted for.
confusable: Not merely controlling an event: A treats independent booking as incomplete trained work and uses the error to keep the pupil explaining.
comparison: Transport escape versus work deadline and altered invitations.
seedUse: D122 Friday/Monday/price/invitations; S05 trained checking of full plan.
